meta.title: Unlock bids "For Myself" with a second-user OTP
gaps: Obtain and enter an OTP delivered to the second user's email/SMS account.
Verify that bids remain hidden from another user with access while visible to the initiating user.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Obtain and enter an OTP delivered to the second user's email/SMS account.; Verify that bids remain hidden from another user with access while visible to the initiating user.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing event whose submission window has closed.
Open the event's Responses tab, which is the subject of the test.
Open the settings action that starts the sealed-bid unlock flow.

args.goal: Choose For Myself, select the second pre-set user as the OTP recipient, and leave the unlock dialog ready to send the OTP.

steps.note: Configure the buyer-side unlock dialog before the external OTP step.

args.need: obtain the OTP from the selected second user, enter it, submit it, and verify that bids are visible to the initiating user but remain hidden for another user with access

steps.note: This requires the second user's email/SMS and another user's session, which the catalog cannot access.
Assert the expected unlock confirmation after OTP verification.
